decisions.why: Examples are CSSD Furniture, Sterilisation Wraps and Cleaning Indicators - core central sterile services decontamination consumables.
Washer disinfectors (TW 3000, PWD 86, DS 800 series) are standard CSSD instrument decontamination equipment.
BP 100 series bedpan washer disinfectors are hospital decontamination equipment in the same product family as Sychem's other CSSD washers.
LC series trolley washer disinfectors are hospital decontamination equipment for reprocessing trolleys.
US series ultrasonic washers are standard instrument decontamination equipment used in sterile services.
VS series steam sterilisers are core CSSD decontamination equipment.
VS L steam sterilisers are the same product family as Sychem's other CSSD steam sterilisers.
PL series low temperature sterilisers process heat-sensitive instruments, standard CSSD equipment.
ID/AD series drying cabinets dry decontaminated instruments after washing, part of CSSD reprocessing equipment.
Tabletop steam sterilisers and washer disinfectors (TTA 23, VS 1 TT, DS 50 series) are compact CSSD decontamination equipment.
Benchtop ultrasonic washer and low temperature steriliser are the same CSSD equipment types as Sychem's other decontamination ranges.
Undercounter Washer Disinfectors is an instrument washer disinfector, matching Sychem's other CSSD washer disinfector products.
VS LD Compact Vertical Steam Steriliser is a steam steriliser matching Sychem's other CSSD steriliser ranges.
